body_html:
Michael “Lil Joe” Waldron is not just a “DJ,” he is an engaging Entertainer and a world-class Emcee. He has been in the Entertainment Business for well over 16 years full time. He has been the national DJ Trainer for multi-million dollar nightclubs, he is an On-Air Personality on 99.9 The Point in Fort Collins, he is a national Voice-Over Talent, along with performing at thousands of events from weddings, school dances, corporate functions and more all across Georgia and the nation.
Some of his past and current clients and present experience includes:
-Madison Square Garden
-McDonald’s
-Denver Broncos
-Bud Light
-Georgia University
-Harlem Globetrotters
-KIA
-Top Golf Radio
-Pandora Internet Radio
-Budweiser Events Center
-Mat Kearney
-Matt Nathanson
-Blue October
-Gavin DeGraw
-And, many others!
